acceptance: No workflow in these repos that runs cargo carries a hand list of forge-run sibling checkouts; each calls checkout-siblings.
forge-cli CI, forge-edge ci and forge-agent ci are green on main after this lands, with run ids in the evidence.
forge-runtime, forge-control-plane ci and forge-lang df-nightly's checkout step succeed on a runner whose workspace was cleaned first.
author: rory
statement: Every hand-written workflow that runs cargo checks out its siblings through the action instead of a list — The lists are what broke: forge-cli ci.yml and release.yml lack forge-platform-wire (Cargo.toml:92 since 390b1c1) and forge-runtime (build.rs:23), red since 2026-09-02 on a hosted runner; forge-edge and forge-agent ci.yml lack forge-lang, red since forge-runtime 6c236324 added forge-lang-interp (forge-runtime/Cargo.toml:498-499, crates/forge-adapters/Cargo.toml:65); forge-runtime ci.yml and release.yml lack forge-lang (green only on stale runner copies); forge-agent and forge-edge release.yml lack sdk-v2, ui, web (and lang); forge-lang df-nightly lacks forge-types. Replace each list with the checkout-siblings action. Also correct the comments claiming dtolnay exports RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN (forge-runtime ci.yml:175, forge-storage ci.yml:79): it does not; rust-toolchain.toml is what pins.
